planets.name: LP 791-18 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LP 791-18 with a 0.948-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: LP 791-18 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around LP 791-18. Its orbit and size follow Peterson et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
